post.content_md:
# 5 Useful PDF Tools for Everyday Tasks

PDF files are part of everyday life.

You may need to combine documents,  
separate pages, or fix a file's layout.

But not every task requires  
a complicated PDF program.

Here are five useful PDF tools  
for common document tasks.

## 1. Merge PDF Files

**When you have several documents  
that need to become one file.**

This is useful for combining  
reports, contracts, invoices,  
or application documents.

Keep related files together  
in one convenient PDF.

[[tool:pdf-merge]]

## 2. Split PDF Files

**When you only need certain pages  
from a large PDF document.**

Instead of sharing an entire file,  
you can separate the pages  
that matter.

Useful for reports, manuals,  
and long documents.

[[tool:pdf-split]]

## 3. Rotate PDF Pages

**When pages appear sideways  
or upside down.**

This often happens with  
scanned documents or files  
created from different sources.

Correct the page orientation  
for easier reading.

[[tool:pdf-rotate]]

## 4. Organize PDF Pages

**When the pages are not  
in the right order.**

You may need to rearrange pages  
or remove unnecessary ones  
before sharing a document.

Organizing pages helps keep  
your PDF clear and easy to follow.

[[tool:pdf-organize]]

## 5. Convert Images to PDF

**When you need to turn photos  
or scanned images into a document.**

This is useful for receipts,  
printed forms, notes,  
and photographed documents.

Bring your images together  
in a PDF file.

[[tool:image-to-pdf]]

## Make PDF Tasks Simpler

Different document tasks  
need different tools.

Whether you are organizing files,  
preparing documents for submission,  
or sharing important information,  
the right PDF tool can save time.

Explore the UTILWISE PDF tools  
and choose the one you need.

**Simple tools for everyday tasks.**
